requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-001 states that the system must strictly block all mainnet network connections, mainnet private key signing, and mainnet transaction broadcasting before opening any socket or unlocking any key.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-001 states that the system must strictly block all mainnet network connections, mainnet private key signing, and mainnet transaction broadcasting before opening any socket or unlocking any key.
requirements.rationale: Defines core security functional behavior required of the system.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-002 states that the system shall resolve the ExecutionTarget tuple (mode, domain, network) first and validate account, artifact, and receipt compatibility before executing any operation.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-002 states that the system shall resolve the ExecutionTarget tuple (mode, domain, network) first and validate account, artifact, and receipt compatibility before executing any operation.
requirements.rationale: Specifies processing steps and validation actions the system must perform.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-004 states that the lock manager must acquire workspace file locks in a strict hierarchical rank order using AsyncLocalStorage reentrancy, recover stale dead-PID locks after 30 seconds, and omit CLI arguments from lockfiles.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-004 states that the lock manager must acquire workspace file locks in a strict hierarchical rank order using AsyncLocalStorage reentrancy, recover stale dead-PID locks after 30 seconds, and omit CLI arguments from lockfiles.
requirements.rationale: Specifies operational functionality and behavior for the lock manager.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-006 states that the toolchain manager must verify exact SHA-256 digests and byte sizes for external kaspa-wasm v2.1.0 and silverc v1.0.0 binaries and pin Docker images rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 and cpuminer by immutable SHA-256 digest.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-006 states that the toolchain manager must verify exact SHA-256 digests and byte sizes for external kaspa-wasm v2.1.0 and silverc v1.0.0 binaries and pin Docker images rusty-kaspad v2.1.0 and cpuminer by immutable SHA-256 digest.
requirements.rationale: Specifies validation and verification functions required of the toolchain manager.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-008 states that the system shall convert between KAS decimal strings and bigint Sompi units (100,000,000 sompi per KAS) without floating-point precision loss and validate network-specific Bech32 address prefixes.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-008 states that the system shall convert between KAS decimal strings and bigint Sompi units (100,000,000 sompi per KAS) without floating-point precision loss and validate network-specific Bech32 address prefixes.
requirements.rationale: Specifies core mathematical conversion and validation capabilities of the system.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-009 states that the configuration loader shall load TypeScript and JavaScript hardkas.config files via jiti and resolve network endpoints, execution targets, and fee policies deterministically.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-009 states that the configuration loader shall load TypeScript and JavaScript hardkas.config files via jiti and resolve network endpoints, execution targets, and fee policies deterministically.
requirements.rationale: Defines the required functional behavior of the configuration loading system.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-010 states that the observability package shall provide structured logging, metric counters, Prometheus text export formatting, and distributed trace spans with zero external runtime dependencies.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-010 states that the observability package shall provide structured logging, metric counters, Prometheus text export formatting, and distributed trace spans with zero external runtime dependencies.
requirements.rationale: Specifies the functional features and observability capabilities to be delivered.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-012 states that the toolchain manager should support pinned silverc v1.0.0 compiler binaries on macOS (darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64) in addition to Windows and Linux, and provide a signed binary for the SilverScript VM runner.
requirements.refined_statement: Requirement HK-REQ-012 states that the toolchain manager should support pinned silverc v1.0.0 compiler binaries on macOS (darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64) in addition to Windows and Linux, and provide a signed binary for the SilverScript VM runner.
requirements.rationale: Specifies platform support and binary generation capabilities required of the system.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-003 states that the security module must strip ANSI escape sequences and redact all 64-hex private keys, extended keys, mnemonics, secret fields, and URL credentials before logging or persisting artifacts.
requirements.refined_statement: The security module shall sanitize 100% of outbound log and persistent artifact streams by stripping ANSI escape sequences and redacting 64-hex private keys, extended keys, mnemonics, secret fields, and URL credentials.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-005 states that all durable state writes must write to a unique temporary sibling file, flush to disk with fsyncSync, and atomically rename with up to 5 backoff retries on Windows EPERM or EBUSY errors.
requirements.refined_statement: All durable state writes shall execute via a unique temporary sibling file, execute fsyncSync to flush to disk, and complete an atomic rename supporting up to 5 exponential backoff retries upon encountering Windows EPERM or EBUSY errors.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-007 states that external binary execution for the SilverScript compiler must use child_process.execFile without shell interpolation to prevent command injection.
requirements.refined_statement: External binary execution for the SilverScript compiler shall exclusively use child_process.execFile with shell interpolation disabled (shell: false) to prevent command injection vulnerabilities across 100% of execution paths.

requirements.statement: Requirement HK-REQ-011 states that the monorepo package dependency graph must strictly obey the five-tier hierarchy from Level 0 Foundations through Level 4 Presentation without upward circular dependencies.
requirements.refined_statement: The monorepo package dependency graph shall statically enforce the strict five-tier hierarchy from Level 0 Foundations to Level 4 Presentation with 0 upward or circular dependencies detected during static analysis checks.
